source: LROC NAC south-pole mosaic, see README.md
sun: low, from upper-left (shadows fall to lower-right)

classes.crater_rim: raised rim / wall band of a real crater (r>=0.5 tile)
classes.crater_floor: inside a real crater, not black
classes.psr: >50% of the tile in permanent/black shadow
classes.steep: rough relief (top 8% local slope proxy) or partly shadowed slopes

config_features.source: game.js pickDeepIceTile(): habitat centre + 22 tiles toward expedition (37,7) -> (37,7)

recommended_config_tweaks.effect: pickDeepIceTile() then lands on tile (36,7): 75% black PSR floor of crater C11 instead of (37,7) (43% black, on the lit inner wall edge). Optional; (37,7) is already inside C11.

notes: crater-s / pit / crater-m positions are hard-coded in game.js bootstrap() stampTerrain(...) and craterM, not config.js
deep ice is not baked into the ground art (it is hidden until unlocked); shallow ice has a faint baked frost glint

placement.note: world(0,0) = pixel (OX,OY) of the 30deg-rotated 1.0 m/px resample; see README
